home.title: Learn at lightning speed!
home.subtitle: Build quizzes in seconds, play live with your class or friends and climb the leaderboard. It feels like a video game, not an exam.

home.feature2Text: Multiple choice, ordering, slider, map pin, word cloud, drawing…
home.feature3Text: Teams, survival, races, boss battle and tournaments.
home.feature4Text: Big buttons, haptics, sounds and installable as an app.
